title: 第5章 初入炼皮第6章 报仇不过夜
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
“顺哥儿，小弟想请问你平时在哪砍的柴啊？教教老弟我呗！”赵寒稍微放低姿态问道。
阿顺一听，瞥了眼赵寒，随后似乎想到什么，笑哈哈道：
“在那边呢，东面的山上呢，一头野兽都没有，还有很多耐烧的柴，砍一天都够两三天用了。”
“多谢顺哥儿指点，小弟感激不尽！”赵寒抱拳谢过。
事不宜迟，立刻去拿砍柴刀和砍柴斧以及背篓和绳子。
以及必备的干粮，也就是几块窝窝头和两个水袋，赵寒并不准备中午回来。
砍柴而已，洒洒水的事。
目视赵寒的背影消失，阿顺冷冷一笑。
他对周边可是熟悉的很，那东面可不算太安全，林区野兽可不少。
什么野猪、野狼、猛虎、金钱豹、豺狼、毒蛇可不在少数。
新来的，就是要吃点苦，受点罪，多给一些教训。
让他们养成依赖老人、尊敬前辈、谨小慎微的性格。
阿顺之前也被老墩子坑过，差点没把命搭进去。
这次坑赵寒，只是把自己曾经遭遇的不爽，施加给赵寒而已。
所谓己所不欲，必施于人。
是死是活，就看你的造化了。
命硬能活下来，命不硬，那就留下尸体。
可是阿顺完全没想到的是，赵寒进了林子后便把背篓和工具一扔。
找了个空地便开始摸鱼，练习黑狼拳。
赵寒又不是傻子。

干活再积极麻利，也不如练武变强。
自己要是成了精锐帮众，还用看王大伟和阿顺的脸色？还用砍柴劈柴？
每天吃肉喝酒，好不自在。
何况，成为精锐帮众，只是赵寒眼中微不足道的一步。
这是一个武道为尊的世界，除了习武之人，还有妖、怪、诡的存在。
为何身处乱世，那么多人活不下去，和妖、怪、诡有很大关联。
来到这个修炼的世界，又有系统加身，要追求的应该是长生久视，无敌于天下！
早些把野狼拳练到熟练，才是正经事。
赵寒看过柴房库存，之前阿顺砍得多，柴火完全足够明日之用，压根不用砍那么多。
只是王大伟这些老人，喜欢压迫新人树立权威，让他听话干活而已。
职场潜规则，很正常，赵寒刷短视频可是了解不少。
“呵呵哈嘿！”
林中，赵寒习练了几个姿势，随后又打了几套黑狼拳加深印象。
【黑狼拳，入门2050】
content_en:
"Brother Shun, I would like to ask where you usually cut firewood? Please teach me!" Zhao Han asked with a slightly lowered attitude.
As soon as Ah Shun heard this, he glanced at Zhao Han, then seemed to think of something, and laughed and said:
"Over there, on the mountain to the east, there's not a single wild beast, and there's a lot of firewood that can be chopped in one day, enough for two or three days."
"Thank you Brother Shun for your advice. I'm very grateful!" Zhao Han thanked him with clasped fists.
Without further ado, go get the woodcutter and woodaxe as well as the backpack and rope.
As well as the necessary dry food, which is a few pieces of steamed bread and two water bags, Zhao Han is not planning to come back at noon.
It's just about chopping firewood and sprinkling water.
Seeing Zhao Han's back disappear, Ah Shun smiled coldly.
He is very familiar with the surrounding area. The east side is not very safe and there are many wild animals in the forest.
There are many wild boars, wild wolves, tigers, leopards, jackals, and poisonous snakes.
The new ones have to endure some hardships, suffer some mistakes, and be taught more lessons.
Let them develop the character of relying on the elderly, respecting their seniors, and being cautious.
Ah Shun had been tricked by Lao Dunzi before and almost lost his life.
This time he tricked Zhao Han, just to inflict on Zhao Han the unhappiness he had experienced.
As the saying goes, you must do to others what you don’t want others to do to you.
Whether you live or die depends on your fate.
If you are lucky, you can survive. If you are not lucky, then the body will be left behind.
But what Ah Shun didn't expect was that Zhao Han threw away his backpack and tools after entering the forest.
I found an open space and started catching fish and practicing Black Wolf Boxing.
Zhao Han is not a fool.
No matter how active and agile you are at work, it is not as good as practicing martial arts to become stronger.
If I become an elite gang member, why should I look at the faces of Wang Dawei and Ah Shun? Still chopping firewood?
Eating meat and drinking alcohol every day makes me feel uncomfortable.
What's more, becoming an elite gang member is just an insignificant step in Zhao Han's eyes.
This is a world where martial arts is respected. In addition to people who practice martial arts, there are also monsters, monsters, and treacherous beings.
Why so many people cannot survive in troubled times has a lot to do with monsters, monsters, and ghosts.
When you come to this world of cultivation and have a system, what you should pursue is longevity and being invincible in the world!
It's a serious matter to practice Wild Wolf Boxing to proficiency early on.
Zhao Han took a look at the inventory of the firewood room. Ashun had chopped a lot before, and the firewood was enough for tomorrow, so there was no need to chop so much.
It's just that old people like Wang Dawei like to pressure newcomers to establish authority and make them do as they are told.
The unspoken rules of the workplace are normal, and Zhao Han knows a lot about them by watching short videos.
"Hehehehe!"
In the forest, Zhao Han practiced several postures, and then performed a few sets of Black Wolf Fist to deepen his impression.
[Black Wolf Fist, Getting Started 2050]
